tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search across the Socials Homes documentation: how it works, pricing, FAQ, terms summary and the housing guides for moving abroad. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet, the resource URI to read in full, and the web page to cite.

query.description: Keywords or a question, for example "cancel subscription" or "documents to rent in Germany".

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.
